title: SEC3: filename validation weaker in kith-chat than kith-peer
description: kith-chat/src/message.rs validate_filename bans only the sequence '../' and absolute paths, but allows embedded '/' (e.g. 'subdir/file.txt' passes). kith-peer validate_attachments bans all '/' and '\' characters. The kith-peer rule is simpler and strictly stronger. The divergence means a filename accepted by Message/set create would be rejected by Peer/deliver for the same payload, and the kith-chat rule is objectively weaker against path component injection. Fix: adopt the same rule as kith-peer — ban all '/' and '\' characters in filenames — which also simplifies the code.
